name: academic-writing-suite
description: Academic research workflow orchestrator: topic selection, experiment design, outline, citation check, language polish, and iterative peer review. Acts as research advisor — never ghostwrites paper text.
descriptionZh: 学术研究全流程编排：选题→实验设计→骨架→引用审查→润色→审稿循环。定位为研究导师而非代笔人——只给规划、建议和修改点，绝不产出论文正文。
